Verses.VerseAr: كٓهٰيٰـعٓـصٓ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Kaf, Ha, Ya, ‘Ain, Sad. (Only Allah and the Messenger know the real meaning.)

Verses.VerseAr: ذِكۡرُ رَحۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَـبۡدَهٗ زَكَرِيَّا ‌ۖ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This is an account of the Mercy of your Lord (bestowed) upon His (chosen) servant Zakariyya (Zacharias),

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡ نَادٰى رَبَّهٗ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: When he called upon his Lord in a low voice (charged with politeness and submissiveness).

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّىۡ وَهَنَ الۡعَظۡمُ مِنِّىۡ وَاشۡتَعَلَ الرَّاۡسُ شَيۡبًا وَّلَمۡ اَكُنۡۢ بِدُعَآٮِٕكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: He submitted: ‘O my Lord, my bones have grown tender and (my) head has turned white like a flame due to old age and, O my Lord, I have never been unblessed when supplicating You.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنِّىۡ خِفۡتُ الۡمَوَالِىَ مِنۡ وَّرَآءِىۡ وَكَانَتِ امۡرَاَتِىۡ عَاقِرًا فَهَبۡ لِىۡ مِنۡ لَّدُنۡكَ وَلِيًّاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And I fear my (disbelieving) relatives (may ruin the blessing of Din [Religion]) after my (soul departs) and my wife (too) is barren. So bless me from Your Presence with an heir (son),

Verses.VerseAr: يَّرِثُنِىۡ وَيَرِثُ مِنۡ اٰلِ يَعۡقُوۡبَ‌ وَاجۡعَلۡهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The one) who should be my heir (of divine blessing) and also the heir of (the chain of Prophethood from) the Children of Ya‘qub (Jacob). And, O my Lord, You (also) make him an awardee of Your Pleasure.’

Verses.VerseAr: يٰزَكَرِيَّاۤ اِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلٰم ۨاسۡمُهٗ يَحۡيٰىۙ لَمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهٗ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ سَمِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Allah said:) ‘O Zakariyya (Zacharias), indeed We give you the good news of a son whose name shall be Yahya (John). We have not given this name to anyone before him.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبِّ اَنّٰى يَكُوۡنُ لِىۡ غُلٰمٌ وَّكَانَتِ امۡرَاَتِىۡ عَاقِرًا وَّقَدۡ بَلَـغۡتُ مِنَ الۡـكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Zakariyya [Zacharias]) submitted: ‘My Lord, how can there be a son to me while my wife is barren, and I have shrivelled (into extreme debility) on account of old age?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ‌ۚ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَّقَدۡ خَلَقۡتُكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ تَكُ شَيْئًا
Verses.VerseEn: (He) said: ‘(Don’t be amazed.) It will be the same way.’ Your Lord said: ‘It is easy for Me (to create a son). Certainly, I created you (too) before, while you were (just) nothing.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبِّ اجۡعَل لِّىۡۤ اٰيَةً‌ ؕ قَالَ اٰيَتُكَ اَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلٰثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Zakariyya [Zacharias]) submitted: ‘My Lord, set a Sign for me.’ He said: ‘Your Sign is that despite good health you shall not be able to speak to the people for three nights (and days).’

Verses.VerseAr: فَخَرَجَ عَلٰى قَوۡمِهٖ مِنَ الۡمِحۡرَابِ فَاَوۡحٰٓى اِلَيۡهِمۡ اَنۡ سَبِّحُوۡا بُكۡرَةً وَّعَشِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then (Zakariyya [Zacharias]) came out from his worshipping chamber to his people and conveyed to them (i.e. made them understand) by gestures to glorify (Allah) morning and evening.

Verses.VerseAr: يٰيَحۡيٰى خُذِ الۡكِتٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍ‌ؕ وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُ الۡحُكۡمَ صَبِيًّاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O Yahya (John)! Hold fast to (Our) Book (the Torah). And We granted him wisdom and vision (Prophethood) while yet a child,

Verses.VerseAr: وَّحَنَانًـا مِّنۡ لَّدُنَّا وَزَكٰوةً ‌ؕ وَّكَانَ تَقِيًّاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (blessed him) with sympathy and tenderness and purity and virtuousness from Our Kind Presence and he was very Godfearing.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّبَرًّۢا بِوَالِدَيۡهِ وَلَمۡ يَكُنۡ جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (He was) greatly righteous (and dutiful) to his parents and was neither disobedient nor arrogant (like common boys).

Verses.VerseAr: وَسَلٰمٌ عَلَيۡهِ يَوۡمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوۡمَ يَمُوۡتُ وَيَوۡمَ يُبۡعَثُ حَيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And peace be on Yahya (John) the day he was born, the day he dies and the day he will be raised up alive.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاذۡكُرۡ فِىۡ الۡـكِتٰبِ مَرۡيَمَ‌ۘ اِذِ انتَبَذَتۡ مِنۡ اَهۡلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرۡقِيًّاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O My Esteemed Beloved,) recite the account of Maryam (Mary) in the Book (the Holy Qur’an) when she separated from her family (adopting seclusion for worship and) moved to the eastern house.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاتَّخَذَتۡ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهِمۡ حِجَابًا فَاَرۡسَلۡنَاۤ اِلَيۡهَا رُوۡحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: So she adopted veiling from them (the family and the people so that the Absolute Divine Beauty unveils Himself). Then We sent Our Spirit (the angel, Jibra’il - Gabriel,) towards her who appeared before her in the complete form of a human being.

Words.MeaningEn: then he assumed for her the likeness
**then he assumed for her the likeness

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَتۡ اِنِّىۡۤ اَعُوۡذُ بِالرَّحۡمٰنِ مِنۡكَ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ تَقِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Maryam [Mary]) said: ‘I seek refuge with the Most Gracious (Lord) from you if you fear (Allah).’

Verses.VerseAr: ‌قَالَ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا رَسُوۡلُ رَبِّكِ‌ۖ لِاَهَبَ لَـكِ غُلٰمًا زَكِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Jibra’il [Gabriel]) said: ‘I am only a messenger from your Lord. (I have come) to bestow upon you a pure son.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَتۡ اَنّٰى يَكُوۡنُ لِىۡ غُلٰمٌ وَّلَمۡ يَمۡسَسۡنِىۡ بَشَرٌ وَّلَمۡ اَكُ بَغِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Maryam [Mary]) said: ‘How can there be a son to me whereas no man has even touched me, nor am I unchaste?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ كَذٰلِكِ‌ۚ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ‌ۚ وَّلِنَجۡعَلَهٗۤ اٰيَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحۡمَةً مِّنَّا‌ۚ وَكَانَ اَمۡرًا مَّقۡضِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Jibra’il [Gabriel]) said: ‘(Do not wonder.) It will be the same way. Your Lord says: This (work) is easy for Me, and (the objective is) that We may make him a Sign for the people and Mercy from Us. And it is a matter (already) decreed.’

Words.MeaningEn: and so that We will make him

Verses.VerseAr: فَحَمَلَتۡهُ فَانتَبَذَتۡ بِهٖ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: So Maryam (Mary) conceived him and positioned herself at a remote site aloof (from the people).

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَجَآءَهَا الۡمَخَاضُ اِلٰى جِذۡعِ النَّخۡلَةِ‌ۚ قَالَتۡ يٰلَيۡتَنِىۡ مِتُّ قَبۡلَ هٰذَا وَكُنۡتُ نَسۡيًا مَّنۡسِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then the birth pangs drove her to the trunk of a palm-tree. She said (in anxiety): ‘Would that I had died before this and had become totally forgotten!’

Verses.VerseAr: فَنَادٰٮهَا مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَاۤ اَلَّا تَحۡزَنِىۡ قَدۡ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحۡتَكِ سَرِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then (Gabriel or ‘Isa [Jesus] himself) called out to her from beneath her: ‘Grieve not. Surely your Lord has made a water spring flow under you (or has created and laid under you a divinely eminent human being).

Verses.VerseAr: وَهُزِّىۡۤ اِلَيۡكِ بِجِذۡعِ النَّخۡلَةِ تُسٰقِطۡ عَلَيۡكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And shake the trunk of date-palm towards you. It will shed fresh ripe dates upon you.

Verses.VerseAr: فَكُلِىۡ وَاشۡرَبِىۡ وَقَرِّىۡ عَيۡنًا‌ۚ فَاِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ الۡبَشَرِ اَحَدًاۙ فَقُوۡلِىۡۤ اِنِّىۡ نَذَرۡتُ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ صَوۡمًا فَلَنۡ اُكَلِّمَ الۡيَوۡمَ اِنۡسِيًّا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So eat and drink and cool (your) eyes (with the sight of your beautiful, lovely baby). Then if you see any man, say (to him by gestures): ‘I have vowed a fast (of silence) to the Most Gracious (Lord), so I shall just not talk to any human being today.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَتَتۡ بِهٖ قَوۡمَهَا تَحۡمِلُهٗ‌ؕ قَالُوۡا يٰمَرۡيَمُ لَقَدۡ جِئۡتِ شَيْئًا فَرِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then, carrying (the baby in her lap), she came to her people. They said: ‘O Maryam (Mary), surely you have brought quite an amazing thing!

Verses.VerseAr: يٰۤاُخۡتَ هٰرُوۡنَ مَا كَانَ اَبُوۡكِ امۡرَاَ سَوۡءٍ وَّمَا كَانَتۡ اُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا‌ ۖ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O sister of Harun (Aaron)! Neither was your father a bad man nor was your mother an unchaste woman.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَشَارَتۡ اِلَيۡهِ‌ؕ قَالُوۡا كَيۡفَ نُـكَلِّمُ مَنۡ كَانَ فِىۡ الۡمَهۡدِ صَبِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: On this Maryam (Mary) pointed to (the baby). They said: ‘How can we talk to him who is (yet) an infant in the cradle?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اِنِّىۡ عَبۡدُ اللّٰهِ ؕ اٰتٰٮنِىَ الۡكِتٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِىۡ نَبِيًّاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The (infant himself) spoke out: ‘I am indeed a servant of Allah. He has given me the Book and has raised me as a Prophet.

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَعَلَنِىۡ مُبَارَكًا اَيۡنَ مَا كُنۡتُ وَاَوۡصٰنِىۡ بِالصَّلٰوةِ وَالزَّكٰوةِ مَا دُمۡتُ حَيًّا‌ۖ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And wherever I may reside, He has made me an embodiment of blessing. And He has enjoined upon me Prayer and Zakat (the Alms-due) as long as I am alive.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّبَرًّا بِۢوٰلِدَتِىۡ وَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡنِىۡ جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (He has made me) treat my mother with excellent morality and has not made me disobedient and ill-fated.

Verses.VerseAr: وَالسَّلٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوۡمَ وُلِدْتُّ وَيَوۡمَ اَمُوۡتُ وَيَوۡمَ اُبۡعَثُ حَيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And peace be upon me on the day of my birth, the day of my demise and the day I shall be raised up alive.’

Verses.VerseAr: ذٰلِكَ عِيۡسَى ابۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ‌ؕ قَوۡلَ الۡحَـقِّ الَّذِىۡ فِيۡهِ يَمۡتَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Such is ‘Isa son of Maryam (Jesus son of Mary. That is) the truth about which these people doubt.

Verses.VerseAr: مَا كَانَ لِلّٰهِ اَنۡ يَّتَّخِذَ مِنۡ وَّلَدٍ‌ۙ سُبۡحٰنَهٗ‌ؕ اِذَا قَضٰٓى اَمۡرًا فَاِنَّمَا يَقُوۡلُ لَهٗ كُنۡ فَيَكُوۡنُؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: It is not Allah’s Glory that He should take (to Himself anyone as) a son. Holy and Glorified is He (above this). When He decrees any matter, He only says to it: ‘Be,’ and it becomes.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ رَبِّىۡ وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَاعۡبُدُوۡهُ‌ؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely Allah is my Lord and your Lord (too). So always worship Him alone. This is the straight path.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاخۡتَلَفَ الۡاَحۡزَابُ مِنۡۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡ‌ۚ فَوَيۡلٌ لِّـلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ مَّشۡهَدِ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then their sects began to differ among themselves. So the disbelievers are doomed due to the presence on the Mighty Day (of Resurrection).

Verses.VerseAr: اَسۡمِعۡ بِهِمۡ وَاَبۡصِرۡۙ يَوۡمَ يَاۡتُوۡنَنَا‌ لٰـكِنِ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ الۡيَوۡمَ فِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: How (curiously) will they hear (with the ears wide open) and how (bewilderedly) will they see (with the eyes stunned) on the Day when they will appear before Us! But today the wrongdoers are but (sunk) into the manifest error.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَنۡذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡحَسۡرَةِ اِذۡ قُضِىَ الۡاَمۡرُ‌‌ۘ وَهُمۡ فِىۡ غَفۡلَةٍ وَّهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And warn them of the Day of Regret (and Shame) when (every) matter shall be decided, but they are rapt in (a state of) negligence and simply do not believe.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَرِثُ الۡاَرۡضَ وَمَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا وَاِلَـيۡنَا يُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely We alone are the inheritor of the earth and (also) of those who dwell on it, and (they all) shall be brought back to Us.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاذۡكُرۡ فِىۡ الۡكِتٰبِ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ  ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ صِدِّيۡقًا نَّبِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And recite the account of Ibrahim (Abraham) in the Book (the Holy Qur’an). Surely he was a Prophet blessed with truthfulness.

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡ قَالَ لِاَبِيۡهِ يٰۤاَبَتِ لِمَ تَعۡبُدُ مَا لَا يَسۡمَعُ وَلَا يُبۡصِرُ وَلَا يُغۡنِىۡ عَنۡكَ شَيْئًا
Verses.VerseEn: When he said to his father (i.e. his uncle Azar who brought him up after his father Tarukh died): ‘O my father, why do you worship these (idols) which cannot hear or see, nor can they remove any (troublesome) thing from you?

Verses.VerseAr: يٰۤاَبَتِ اِنِّىۡ قَدۡ جَآءَنِىۡ مِنَ الۡعِلۡمِ مَا لَمۡ يَاۡتِكَ فَاتَّبِعۡنِىۡۤ اَهۡدِكَ صِرَاطًا سَوِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: O Father! No doubt there has come to me knowledge (from the Divine Presence of Allah) which has not come to you. Follow me; I shall show you the straight path.

Verses.VerseAr: يٰۤاَبَتِ لَا تَعۡبُدِ الشَّيۡطٰنَ‌ؕ اِنَّ الشَّيۡطٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ عَصِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: O Father! Do not worship Satan. Surely Satan is a great rebel against the Most Kind (Lord).

Verses.VerseAr: يٰۤاَبَتِ اِنِّىۡۤ اَخَافُ اَنۡ يَّمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ فَتَكُوۡنَ لِلشَّيۡطٰنِ وَلِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Father! Indeed I fear that a torment from Most Kind (Lord) may seize you and you become a companion of Satan.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اَرَاغِبٌ اَنۡتَ عَنۡ اٰلِهَتِىۡ يٰۤاِبۡرٰهِيۡمُ‌ۚ لَٮِٕنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَهِ لَاَرۡجُمَنَّكَ‌ وَاهۡجُرۡنِىۡ مَلِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Azar) said: ‘Ibrahim (Abraham), have you turned away from my gods? If you do not practically desist (from this opposition) I will certainly stone you to death. And keep away from me for a long while.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيۡكَ‌ۚ سَاَسۡتَغۡفِرُ لَـكَ رَبِّىۡؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ بِىۡ حَفِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Ibrahim (Abraham) said: ‘(All right,) peace be on you. I shall beg forgiveness for you from my Lord (even) now. He is indeed very kind to me. (He may bestow guidance upon you.)

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَعۡتَزِلُـكُمۡ وَمَا تَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ وَاَدۡعُوۡا رَبِّىۡ‌‌ۖ عَسٰٓى اَلَّاۤ اَكُوۡنَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّىۡ شَقِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And I turn away from you (all) and these (idols) which you worship besides Allah. And I worship my Lord (with absolute concentration). I hope that, owing to worship of my Lord, I shall not be deprived (of His Bounty).’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا اعۡتَزَلَهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِۙ وَهَبۡنَا لَهٗۤ اِسۡحٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَ‌ؕ وَكُلاًّ جَعَلۡنَا نَبِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: So when Ibrahim (Abraham, giving up all social links,) completely separated from the people and those (idols) that they worshipped apart from Allah, We blessed him with Ishaq (Isaac) and Ya‘qub (Jacob, son and grandson) and We made each of them a Prophet.

Verses.VerseAr: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ رَّحۡمَتِنَا وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ عَلِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We awarded (all of) them Our (special) Mercy and put their praise and admiration on high rhetoric (among the believers of every divine religion).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاذۡكُرۡ فِىۡ الۡكِتٰبِ مُوۡسٰٓى‌ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مُخۡلَصًا وَّكَانَ رَسُوۡلاً نَّبِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And recite the account of Musa (Moses) in (this Holy) Book. Surely, (getting rid of the grip of self,) he had become exalted and was a Messenger and Prophet.

Verses.VerseAr: وَنَادَيۡنٰهُ مِنۡ جَانِبِ الطُّوۡرِ الۡاَيۡمَنِ وَقَرَّبۡنٰهُ نَجِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We called him out from the right of (Mount) Tur and blessed him with Our (special) nearness for secret converse.

Verses.VerseAr: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهٗ مِنۡ رَّحۡمَتِنَاۤ اَخَاهُ هٰرُوۡنَ نَبِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We granted him out of Our Mercy his brother Harun (Aaron), making him a Prophet (to assist him in his task).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاذۡكُرۡ فِىۡ الۡـكِتٰبِ اِسۡمٰعِيۡلَ‌ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ صَادِقَ الۡوَعۡدِ وَكَانَ رَسُوۡلاً نَّبِيًّا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And recite the account of Isma‘il (Ishmael) in (this) Book. Surely he was true to (his) promise and was a Messenger and Prophet.

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَانَ يَاۡمُرُ اَهۡلَهٗ بِالصَّلٰوةِ وَالزَّكٰوةِ وَكَانَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهٖ مَرۡضِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And he used to enjoin on his family Prayer and Zakat (the Alms-due) and (held) the station of Mardiyya in the Presence of his Lord (i.e. his Lord was well pleased with him).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاذۡكُرۡ فِىۡ الۡكِتٰبِ اِدۡرِيۡسَ‌ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ صِدِّيۡقًا نَّبِيًّاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And mention in the Book the account of Idris. Verily he was a Prophet possessing the Truth.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّرَفَعۡنٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We raised him to a lofty station.

Verses.VerseAr: اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ الَّذِيۡنَ اَنۡعَمَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنَ النَّبِيّٖنَ مِنۡ ذُرِّيَّةِ اٰدَمَ وَمِمَّنۡ حَمَلۡنَا مَعَ نُوۡحٍ وَّمِنۡ ذُرِّيَّةِ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ وَاِسۡرآءِيۡلَ وَمِمَّنۡ هَدَيۡنَا وَاجۡتَبَيۡنَا‌ؕ اِذَا تُتۡلٰى عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتُ الرَّحۡمٰنِ خَرُّوۡا سُجَّدًا وَّبُكِيًّا ۩‏
Verses.VerseEn: These are the people on whom Allah bestowed Favour from among the Prophets of the seed of Adam and of those (believers) whom We (saved from Deluge and) carried with Nuh (Noah) in the Ark, and of the posterity of Ibrahim (Abraham) and Isra‘il (Israel i.e. Ya‘qub [Jacob]) and of those (chosen ones) whom We guided and exalted. When the Verses of the Most Kind (Lord) are recited to them, they fall down prostrating themselves in (profuse) tears.

Verses.VerseAr: فَخَلَفَ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ خَلۡفٌ اَضَاعُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاتَّبَعُوا الشَّهٰوتِ‌ فَسَوۡفَ يَلۡقَوۡنَ غَيًّاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then followed their pathetic successors who gave up Prayers and followed lusts (of their ill-commanding selves). So they will soon face punishment in the Hereafter (in the Ghayi valley of Hell),

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا مَنۡ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًـا فَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ يَدۡخُلُوۡنَ الۡجَـنَّةَ وَلَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ شَيْئًا
Verses.VerseEn: Except someone who repents and believes and persists in righteous works; they will enter Paradise and will not be wronged in the least.

Verses.VerseAr: جَنّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ۨالَّتِىۡ وَعَدَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ عِبَادَهٗ بِالۡغَيۡبِ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ وَعۡدُهٗ مَاۡتِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (They will dwell) in such evergreen gardens which the Most Kind (Lord) has promised to His servants in the Unseen. Certainly His promise is about to come true.

Verses.VerseAr: لَّا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا لَـغۡوًا اِلَّا سَلٰمًا‌ؕ وَلَهُمۡ رِزۡقُهُمۡ فِيۡهَا بُكۡرَةً وَّعَشِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will not hear in it any absurd talk but only greetings of peace (pouring in from every direction). For them, their sustenance will be (available) in it morning and evening.

Verses.VerseAr: تِلۡكَ الۡجَـنَّةُ الَّتِىۡ نُوۡرِثُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا مَنۡ كَانَ تَقِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: This is the Paradise which We shall award as inheritance to those of Our servants who are God-fearing.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ اِلَّا بِاَمۡرِ رَبِّكَ‌ۚ لَهٗ مَا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡنَا وَمَا خَلۡفَنَا وَمَا بَيۡنَ ذٰلِكَ‌ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O Jibra’il [Gabriel], say to My Beloved:) ‘We cannot descend (onto earth) without the Command of your Lord. To Him belongs whatever is before us and whatever is behind us and whatever is in between. And your Lord is never forgetful (of you).

Verses.VerseAr: رَّبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فَاعۡبُدۡهُ وَاصۡطَبِرۡ لِـعِبَادَتِهٖ‌ؕ هَلۡ تَعۡلَمُ لَهٗ سَمِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (He) is the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between the two. So worship Him and remain steadfast in His worship. Do you know who is His namesake?

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَقُوۡلُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ ءَاِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوۡفَ اُخۡرَجُ حَيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And man says: ‘Shall I be soon brought forth alive when I die?’

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَا يَذۡكُرُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ اَنَّا خَلَقۡنٰهُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ يَكُ شَيْئًا
Verses.VerseEn: Does man not remember that We had created him before this (also) while he was just nothing?

Verses.VerseAr: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَـنَحۡشُرَنَّهُمۡ وَالشَّيٰطِيۡنَ ثُمَّ لَــنُحۡضِرَنَّهُمۡ حَوۡلَ جَهَـنَّمَ جِثِيًّا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So, by your Lord, We will certainly gather them and (all) Satans together (on the Day of Judgment). We will then bring them (all) around Hell fallen down in kneeling position.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ لَـنَنۡزِعَنَّ مِنۡ كُلِّ شِيۡعَةٍ اَيُّهُمۡ اَشَدُّ عَلَى الرَّحۡمٰنِ عِتِيًّا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We shall indeed pick out from every group the one who had been most disobedient to and rebellious against the Most Kind (Lord).

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ لَـنَحۡنُ اَعۡلَمُ بِالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ اَوۡلٰى بِهَا صِلِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We know best those who are most deserving of being thrown into Hell.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنۡ مِّنْکُمْ اِلَّا وَارِدُهَا‌ؕ كَانَ عَلٰى رَبِّكَ حَتۡمًا مَّقۡضِيًّا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And there is none of you but will pass over Hell. This (promise) is absolutely with your Lord which will certainly be fulfilled.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ نُـنَجِّىۡ الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوْا وَّنَذَرُ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا جِثِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We shall deliver the God-fearing and shall leave the wrongdoers in it (Hell) down on their knees.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا تُتۡلٰى عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنٰتٍ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡۤاۙ اَىُّ الۡفَرِيۡقَيۡنِ خَيۡرٌ مَّقَامًا وَّاَحۡسَنُ نَدِيًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when Our enlightening Verses are recited to them, the disbelievers say to the believers: ‘(See in the selfsame world) which of us two groups has better housing and more influential social circle.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ اَحۡسَنُ اَثَاثًا وَّرِءۡيًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And how many a people have We destroyed before them who were better off (than these) in worldly assets and pomp and show.

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ مَنۡ كَانَ فِىۡ الضَّلٰلَةِ فَلۡيَمۡدُدۡ لَهُ الرَّحۡمٰنُ مَدًّا‌ ‌ۚ حَتّٰٓى اِذَا رَاَوۡا مَا يُوۡعَدُوۡنَ اِمَّا الۡعَذَابَ وَاِمَّا السَّاعَةَ ؕ فَسَيَـعۡلَمُوۡنَ مَنۡ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَّاَضۡعَفُ جُنۡدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘The Most Kind (Lord also) grants respite in age and luxury to the one who is lost in error until, when they see what they have been promised — torment or the Day of Rising — then they will come to know him who is worse in respect of dwelling and (also) weaker in respect of troops.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَزِيۡدُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡنَ اهۡتَدَوۡا هُدًى‌ؕ وَالۡبٰقِيٰتُ الصّٰلِحٰتُ خَيۡرٌ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَّخَيۡرٌ مَّرَدًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah adds to the guidance of those who are guided aright. And in the sight of your Lord, the lasting pious deeds are better in respect of reward and (also) more valuable in terms of end result.

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَرَءَيۡتَ الَّذِىۡ كَفَرَ بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَاُوۡتَيَنَّ مَالاً وَّوَلَدًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have you seen such a person that rejected Our Signs and said: ‘I shall certainly be given wealth and children (the same way even on the Day of Resurrection)’?

Verses.VerseAr: اَطَّلَعَ الۡغَيۡبَ اَمِ اتَّخَذَ عِنۡدَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ عَهۡدًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Is he aware of the unseen or has he taken any promise from the Most Kind (Lord)?

Verses.VerseAr: كَلَّا‌ ؕ سَنَكۡتُبُ مَا يَقُوۡلُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهٗ مِنَ الۡعَذَابِ مَدًّاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: No way! We shall keep writing down what he says, and shall keep increasing for him torment (upon torment).

Verses.VerseAr: وَنَرِثُهٗ مَا يَقُوۡلُ وَيَاۡتِيۡنَا فَرۡدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (after his death) We shall inherit from him what he proclaims, and he will come to Us all alone (without wealth and children).

Words.MeaningEn: and he will come to Us

Verses.VerseAr: وَاتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اٰلِهَةً لِّيَكُوۡنُوۡا لَهُمۡ عِزًّاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they have taken (many other) gods apart from Allah so that they may be a source of honour for them.

Verses.VerseAr: كَلَّا‌ؕ سَيَكۡفُرُوۡنَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمۡ وَيَكُوۡنُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضِدًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: By no means! Soon will these (false gods themselves) reject their worship and become their enemies.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اَنَّاۤ اَرۡسَلۡنَا الشَّيٰـطِيۡنَ عَلَى الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ تَؤُزُّهُمۡ اَزًّاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have you not seen that We have sent satans upon the disbelievers? They keep rousing them (against Islam) all the time.

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ‌ؕ اِنَّمَا نَـعُدُّ لَهُمۡ عَدًّا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So do not make haste against them (for torment). We Ourselves keep counting days (for their catastrophe).

Verses.VerseAr: ۙ يَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ اِلَى الرَّحۡمٰنِ وَفۡدًا‌ۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: On the Day when We shall assemble the Godfearing lot and take them (as guests of honour) to the Presence of the Most Kind (Lord) on carriages;

Verses.VerseAr: وَّنَسُوۡقُ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ اِلٰى جَهَـنَّمَ وِرۡدًا‌ۘ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We shall drive the sinners thirsty towards Hell;

Verses.VerseAr: لَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ الشَّفَاعَةَ اِلَّا مَنِ اتَّخَذَ عِنۡدَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ عَهۡدًا‌ۘ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (On that Day) people will not possess the authority to intercede except those who have taken a promise (of intercession) from the Most Kind (Lord).

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالُوۡا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَلَدًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (the disbelievers) say: ‘The Most Kind (Lord) has taken (to Himself) a son.’

Verses.VerseAr: لَـقَدۡ جِئۡتُمۡ شَيْئًا اِدًّاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O disbelievers!) You have indeed brought most horrible and unusual evil (on your tongues).

Verses.VerseAr: تَكَادُ السَّمٰوٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَتَـنۡشَقُّ الۡاَرۡضُ وَتَخِرُّ الۡجِبَالُ هَدًّاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The heavens may just burst at this (fabricated lie) and the earth split asunder and the mountains fall down to pieces,

Verses.VerseAr: اَنۡ دَعَوۡا لِـلرَّحۡمٰنِ وَلَدًا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That they have attributed a son to the Most Kind (Lord).

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا يَنۡۢبَـغِىۡ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ اَنۡ يَّتَّخِذَ وَلَدًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And it is not the Glory of the Most Kind (Lord) to take (someone as) a son.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنۡ كُلُّ مَنۡ فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّاۤ اٰتِىۡ الرَّحۡمٰنِ عَبۡدًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Whoever are (dwelling) in the heavens and the earth (whether angels, jinn or human beings) appear just as servants before the Most Kind Allah.

Verses.VerseAr: لَـقَدۡ اَحۡصٰٮهُمۡ وَعَدَّهُمۡ عَدًّاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Allah) has surely encompassed them with His (knowledge) and has counted them thoroughly (i.e. numbering them one by one).

Verses.VerseAr: وَكُلُّهُمۡ اٰتِيۡهِ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ فَرۡدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And each one of them has to appear before His Presence alone on the Day of Resurrection.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ سَيَجۡعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وُدًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely those who believed and did pious deeds, the Most Kind (Lord) will create love for them in the hearts (of the people).

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ وَتُنۡذِرَ بِهٖ قَوۡمًا لُّدًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: So We have indeed made this (Qur’an) easy in your own tongue so that, by means of it, you may communicate good news to the God-fearing and may warn thereby the contentious people.

Words.MeaningEn: that you may give glad tidings

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡنٍؕ هَلۡ تُحِسُّ مِنۡهُمۡ مِّنۡ اَحَدٍ اَوۡ تَسۡمَعُ لَهُمۡ رِكۡزًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And how many a community have We destroyed before them! Do you perceive even a trace or hear even the faintest fizzle of anyone of them?
